title: Menuella Declarations (structural)
description: Menuella Declarations — Menuella's standardized menu disclosure vocabulary: 22 keys covering additive declarations plus beverage declarations, mandatory warnings and other product-specific indications, distinguished by `category`. Designed for portability and consistency across supported regions; NOT intended to represent any country's official legal terminology. The vocabulary was inspired by common German restaurant menu practice, then generalized — packaging-only entries (protective atmosphere, iodised salt, cocoa fat glaze, taurine, GMO, oxygen colour stabilisation, elevated-caffeine package warnings) are excluded as unsuitable for a menu. Keys are semantic and stable; printed numbering is a render-time projection, see data/codes.json. The property name `additives` is retained for compatibility with consuming systems. Labels live in data/translations/declarations/<lang>.json.

key.description: Stable semantic identifier, and the join key with the translation files. Never renamed or reused.

category.description: What kind of declaration this is. ADDITIVE = LMZDV additive declaration; BEVERAGE = beverage-specific declaration; WARNING = mandatory warning; PRODUCT = other product-specific indication.

icon.description: Basename of an SVG in icons/ — e.g. "cereals" is icons/cereals.svg. Named after the group, not after what it depicts, so the drawing can change without the contract changing.
